description: Elections Commission - Declare that H. G. A. Nilmini Silva was selected as the member of the Moratuwa Municipal Council
reasoning: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Moratuwa Municipal Council) due to a member's failure to attend meetings. It specifically references the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance and details the process for nominating a replacement member through a recognized political party. This content falls squarely under electoral processes and local authority member declarations, making it a clear example of an Elections Gazette (Type 7).
